meta.name: faceless-explainer
meta.description: Turn arbitrary text — an article, notes, a topic, a brief — into a faceless explainer video: there is no site or footage to capture, so the visuals are invented per scene (typography, abstract graphics, diagrams, data-viz). Use for topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos, listicles. Not a video built from a website (/product-launch-video — promo or tour). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将任意文本变成配图解的解说视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想不露脸就把文字稿变成解说视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn any text into a faceless explainer video with generated graphics
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to turn articles or notes into explainer videos without filming anything.

howto.what: 把一段文字(文章、笔记、主题等)交给它,它会做成无人出镜的解说视频:不拍摄真实素材,每个场景现设计排版、图形、图表等视觉;随后创建分镜、文稿、语音和画面,最终渲染出视频。
howto.when: 当用户提供一段文字(文章、笔记、主题等)并要求做成讲解视频时触发,常见用途如主题解说、概念拆解、教程等。此技能不做网站实拍/录屏类视频;若意图不明确,会转去 /hyperframes。

say.text: 把这篇文章做成无人出镜的解说视频。
say.note: 它会先完成项目设置,然后开始制作。

say.text: 用这段笔记做一个概念拆解视频。
say.note: 它会围绕主题设计画面并生成配音。

say.text: 把这份操作步骤做成教程清单视频。
say.note: 它会将每个步骤做成画面并渲染成片。

howto.what_en: Given text (article, notes, topic), it makes a faceless explainer video: no real capture, per-scene visuals are designed (typography, graphics, charts). Then it creates storyboard, script, voice, frames, and renders a video.
howto.when_en: Triggered when user gives text (article, notes, topic) and asks for an explainer video. Uses: topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos. Not for site-capture/tour videos; unclear → /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Turn this article into a faceless explainer video.
say_en.note: It completes setup and begins production.

say_en.text: Use these notes to make a concept-breakdown video.
say_en.note: It designs visuals and adds voiceover.

say_en.text: Turn this procedure into a how-to list video.
say_en.note: It turns steps into frames and renders the final video.
